p: It is brought in the holy sefer Avodas Yisrael
on the statement of our Sages, of blessed memory
than the day on which the Torah was given,
as it says, 'My teaching shall drop like the rain'
who is made dependent on whom," et cetera,
to the day of Shemini Atzeres,
which is called the day of rain,
since on it we bless for rain.
That is because concerning the day of Shemini Atzeres
it is brought in the Tikkunim
that on it is the wellspring of the Torah;
and it is the aspect of the novel insight
and it is the aspect of the watering of the Tree
(הַקְדָּמַת תִּקּוּנֵי זֹהַר, פָּתַח אֵלִיָּהוּ, יז, א)
the aspect of the Written Torah,
which is called the Tree of Life:
"It is a tree of life to those who grasp it"
and the yearning to come from it
to the aspect of the Written Torah,
"For as the rain comes down, etc.,
that goes forth from My mouth;
it shall not return to Me empty,
"My word that goes forth from My mouth"
is the aspect of the Oral Torah,
and it is called like rain
and makes it bring forth and sprout.
And it is a borrowed term
for every root of the source of blessing,
"And it will be, if you diligently listen
I will give the rain of your land in its season, etc."
"I will give your rains in their season, etc."
And also in the generation of the Flood,
all the fountains of the great deep burst forth,
and the windows of the heavens were opened"
and the hint to this is brought
that the gate of wisdom was opened Above
and the wellspring of wisdom below.
For in truth at that time
for the bestowal of the wisdoms of the Torah,
had the generation been worthy of it,
as is known from the holy sefarim.
And to this our Sages, of blessed memory, hinted
that great is the day of rain,
namely, the day of Shemini Atzeres,
on which is the wellspring of the Torah,
more than the day on which was given
That is because on the day of Shemini Atzeres
the source of renewal of the Torah is opened
"My teaching shall drop like the rain."
and it is made dependent on the rain,
of the renewal of words of Torah,
